title: Hawaii National Guard sends additional resources to resupply Kauai ahead of Hurricane Lowell.
description: Just ahead of Hurricane Lowell passing over Kauai County, a Hawaii National Guard Ch-47 Chinook helicopter gets loaded at Kalaeloa, Hawaii on September 9, 2026. The helicopter is taking additional troops, equipment and supplies to the Hawaii National Guard's Task Force based on Kauai. As Hurricane Lowell veers east toward Kauai, the Garden Island, the rain, wind and storm surge are anticipated to have a significant impacts and cause damage. The Hawaii National Guard is ready to provide the support Kauai County needs. (U.S. Army National Guard photo by retired Tech. Sgt. Andrew Jackson)
unit_name: State of Hawaii, Department of Defense, Public Affairs Office
